Package hadur117.core.melee

Class MeleeEnergyPolicy

java.lang.Object
hadur117.core.melee.MeleeEnergyPolicy
public final class MeleeEnergyPolicy extends Object
Melee bullet power (MGUN-2, MGUN-3), the plan's energy table:
  • a finisher (target energy at most FINISHER_ENERGY) gets the power that kills it exactly, at most 3;
  • with two opponents or fewer left, the duel's own table (1.95, 2.95 inside 150 px, powering down beyond 325 px as energy runs low);
  • otherwise 1.0 beyond 500 px or below 20 energy (0.5 below 10), 1.5 at 300-500 px, and 2.0 inside 300 px rising to 3.0 at 150 px.

Nothing is fired below MIN_OWN_ENERGY, a shot never costs more than what kills the target, and while Hadur leads the target on energy a shot never drops it below the target's.

On a team (MGUN-6, teamPower(double, double, double)) a member with TEAM_FULL_POWER_ENERGY or more fires 3, or what kills the target, in place of the table: the table is a free-for-all's, and on the team ladder its light shots let rounds run a third longer than a team firing hard (docs/bench/team-lower-half.md, sections 10 and 11).

    • teamPower

      public static double teamPower(double tablePower, double ownEnergy, double targetEnergy)
      MGUN-6: the power a member on a team fires, given the table's tablePower. A hold (0) stands; with TEAM_FULL_POWER_ENERGY or more own energy the shot is 3, or what kills the target, whatever the table said (its lead cap and two-left row included); below that the table stands.

    • crowdPower

      public static double crowdPower(double tablePower, double distance, double ownEnergy, double targetEnergy, int others)
      MGUN-12, MGUN-13: off a team, the power for a target with others opponents alive, given the table's tablePower. A hold (0) stands, as do a finisher, fewer than three opponents and own energy under CROWD_RULE_ENERGY; otherwise a switched-on rule replaces the table's power, still capped by what kills the target, by the lead over it and by Hadur's own energy, as the table is. With both switches off the table stands.
